overview_description: Manage labours in Exsited: labours, labour profiles and their sessions, availability, booking windows and orders.
intro: Labours are the people or resources you book on orders, and labour profiles set their prices, sessions and availability. You can manage labours and profiles, set availability, find labours free to book and list the orders that book a labour. This area has 19 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **A booked labour cannot be deleted, and deletes cannot be undone.** Cancel a booked labour instead; a deleted labour or labour profile then returns `404`.
notes: **Bodies go under a wrapper key.** Labours go under `labour`, profiles under `labour_profile`, and the bulk availability update under `labours`; single records come back under `labour`, `labour_profile`, `labour_profile_session` or `labour_calendar`.
**A labour profile needs at least one session.** A create without `labour_profile_sessions` is refused with `400`.
**A labour names its profile by `name`.** Send the profile's `name` as `labour.labour_profile` when you create a labour.
**Cancel and reactivate take an empty JSON object.** Cancel sets `status` to `inactive`, reactivate sets it to `active`, and reactivating an active labour is refused.
**Some routes take the labour's `code`.** The orders route takes the `code`, the calendar takes the `id` or the `code`, and the other labour routes take the `id`.
**Date ranges are query parameters.** The availability list takes `start_date` and `end_date` as `YYYY-MM-DD`; the booking search takes them as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

endpoints.title: List labour availability
endpoints.summary: Lists each labour with its schedule and sessions for a date range.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of labours under `data`, each with its `labour_profile`, `schedule_list`, `session_list`, `available_list` and `unavailable_list`. Pass `start_date` and `end_date` to set the range. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The first day of the range, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The last day of the range, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

endpoints.title: List labour profiles
endpoints.summary: Lists labour profiles, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of labour profiles under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Each profile carries its `currency`, `tax`, `sessions` (with prices, availability and working hours) and the `labours` that use it. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a labour profile
endpoints.summary: Creates a labour profile with its sessions, prices and availability.
endpoints.description: Send the profile under `labour_profile` with at least one entry in `labour_profile_sessions`; each session has its dates, `labour_profile_session_prices` and `labour_profile_session_availability`. A profile without sessions is refused with `400`. The new profile comes back under `labour_profile`.

labour_profile_sessions.description: At least one session; a profile without sessions is refused with `400`.

start_date.description: The first day of the session, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.description: The last day of the session, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

price_type.description: How the price applies, such as `HOURLY`.

preferred_day.description: The day of the week, in lower case, such as `monday`.

endpoints.title: List labours
endpoints.summary: Lists labours, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of labours under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Each labour carries its `id`, `code`, `name`, `status`, `labour_profile`, `labour_contacts` and availability. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Create a labour
endpoints.summary: Creates a labour on a labour profile and returns it under `labour`.
endpoints.description: Send the new labour under `labour` with its `name`, `display_name`, `email_address` and the `name` of its `labour_profile`. The new labour comes back under `labour`, with its `id` and `code`.

labour_profile.description: The `name` of the labour profile to use.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a labour profile
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one labour profile with its sessions and labours.
endpoints.description: Returns the profile under `labour_profile`, including its `sessions`, `labours` and `activity_logs`.

parameters.name: labour_profile_id
parameters.description: The labour profile's `id`.

404.description: No labour profile has that `id`, for example because it has been deleted.

endpoints.title: Update a labour profile
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `labour_profile`, such as `display_name`. Read the profile afterwards to see the stored values.

parameters.name: labour_profile_id
parameters.description: The labour profile's `id`.

endpoints.title: Delete a labour profile
endpoints.description: Deletes the labour profile with this `id`. Reading the profile afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: labour_profile_id
parameters.description: The labour profile's `id`.

endpoints.title: List labours available for booking
endpoints.summary: Lists the labours free to book in a time window.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of labours under `data` that can be booked between `start_date` and `end_date`, each given as a date and time. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start of the booking window, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end of the booking window, as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

200.description: One page of labours free to book.

endpoints.title: Update a labour
endpoints.summary: Updates a labour and returns it under `labour`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `labour`, such as `description`. The updated labour comes back under `labour`.

parameters.name: labour_uuid
parameters.description: The labour's `id`.

endpoints.title: Delete a labour
endpoints.summary: Deletes a labour; the response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the labour with this `id`. A successful delete returns `204` with no body, and reading the labour afterwards returns `404`. A labour that has been booked on an order cannot be deleted; cancel it instead.

parameters.name: labour_uuid
parameters.description: The labour's `id`.

204.description: The labour is deleted. No body.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a labour
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one labour with its profile, contacts and availability.
endpoints.description: Returns the labour under `labour`, including its `labour_profile`, `labour_contacts`, `labour_custom_availability` and `activity_logs`.

parameters.name: labour_uuid
parameters.description: The labour's `id`.

404.description: No labour has that `id`, for example because it has been deleted.

endpoints.title: Cancel a labour
endpoints.summary: Makes a labour inactive and returns it under `labour`.
endpoints.description: Send an empty JSON object as the body. The labour's `status` becomes `inactive`, and the labour comes back under `labour`. Use reactivate to make it active again.

parameters.name: labour_id
parameters.description: The labour's `id`.

endpoints.title: Reactivate a labour
endpoints.summary: Makes a cancelled labour active again and returns it under `labour`.
endpoints.description: Send an empty JSON object as the body. The labour's `status` becomes `active`, and the labour comes back under `labour`. Reactivating a labour that is already active is refused with a `4xx` error.

parameters.name: labour_id
parameters.description: The labour's `id`.

endpoints.title: List a labour's orders
endpoints.summary: Lists the orders that book one labour.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of the orders that book this labour under `data`, with `pagination`. The path takes the labour's `code`. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: labour_uuid
parameters.description: The labour's `code`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

200.description: One page of the labour's orders.

endpoints.title: Update labour availability in bulk
endpoints.summary: Sets the availability slots of one or more labours in one call.
endpoints.description: Send `labours`, an array with one entry per labour: its `id` and the slots to set in `labour_availability` or `labour_custom_availability`. Each slot has a `preferred_day`, `start_time`, `end_time` and `available`. A successful update returns `204` with no body.

preferred_day.description: The day of the week, in lower case, such as `monday`.
The day of the week, in lower case, such as `monday`.

204.description: The availability is updated. No body.

endpoints.title: List a labour profile's sessions
endpoints.summary: Lists the sessions of one labour profile.
endpoints.description: Returns the profile's sessions under `data`, with `pagination`. Each session carries its dates, `prices`, `availability` and `working_hours`. A profile with no sessions returns an empty `data` list. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: labour_profile_id
parameters.description: The labour profile's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

200.description: One page of the profile's sessions.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a labour profile session
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one session of a labour profile.
endpoints.description: Returns the session under `labour_profile_session`, with its dates, `prices`, `availability` and `working_hours`.

parameters.name: labour_profile_id
parameters.description: The labour profile's `id`.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: The session's `id`, from the profile's session list.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a labour's availability calendar
endpoints.description: Returns the labour's calendar under `labour_calendar`, in the same form as one entry of the labour availability list: its schedule, sessions and available and unavailable slots. The path takes the labour's `id` or its `code`.

parameters.name: labour_id
parameters.description: The labour's `id` or its `code`.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Rely on this rather than on `next_cursor`, which can still hold a value on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page.
